November 6, 30.

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you
that a telegram has been received from the
Hongkong Police which reads as follows:-

"J.A. Staritzin Russian wishes to come
"to Hongkong as Riding Boy at Jardine
"Stable, leaving eight of November
"Kefer Breitung Meyerinck Company
"fullstop. If no objections request
"Consul General grant Visa
Wolfe
Hongkong"

There is nothing in Municipal Police
records against Ivan Alexandrovitch Staritzin,
and I should be glad if you would kindly grant
him a visa to proceed to Hongkong.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Deputy Commissioner
(Crime & Special Branches)

H.B.M. Consul-General,
Shanghai.

File No. ______
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Special Branch No. 2 Station,
REPORT
Date November 6, 1930.
Subject (in full) Ivan A. Staritzin.
Made by D.S. Prokofiev. Forwarded by [Signature]
Sir,
Reference to attached.
Enquiries go to show that Ivan Alexandrovitch Staritzin,
28 years of age, native of Transbaikalian Province, Russia,
arrived in Shanghai from Vladivostok via Gensan (Korea) with
General Gleboff's cossack detachment in the autumn of 1923.
From August 1924 until the end of 1926 he worked as a riding
boy at the Gordon Road Riding School. After this establishment
was closed down he secured employment in the same capacity
at the Shanghai Race Club, where he is still employed.
He is registered at the Russian Emigrants' Committee.
There is nothing in Municipal Police records to his detriment.
A. Prokofiev
D. S. 9
D. C. (C. & S. Branches)
Reg. Please prepare letter to
Consul General explaining situation
and asking that visa be granted.
[Signature]
6/11/30.

事由（全称） Ivan A. Staritzin。
制作人 D.S. Prokofiev。转呈人 [签名]
先生，
参阅附件。
经查，Ivan Alexandrovitch Staritzin，
28岁，俄罗斯外贝加尔省人，于1923年秋随
Gleboff 将军的哥萨克分队，经元山（朝鲜）从符拉迪沃斯托克抵达上海。
自1924年8月至1926年底，他在戈登路骑术学校担任骑马童。该机构
关闭后，他在上海跑马总会获得同等职位的雇佣，目前仍受雇于此。
他已在俄国侨民委员会登记。
工部局警务处档案中并无对其不利的记录。
A. Prokofiev
D. S. 9
副总监（刑事及特别股）
批注：请拟函致
总领事，说明情况
并请求签发签证。
[签名]
1930年11月6日。
